description: Change target group configuration (algorithm, sticky session, proxy protocol)

algorithmTypeCode.description: Load balancing algorithm type code (RR, SIPHS, LC, MH). HTTP/HTTPS/PROXY_TCP: RR|SIPHS|LC, TCP/UDP: RR|MH

useProxyProtocol.description: Whether to use proxy protocol (true/false). Available for PROXY_TCP protocol only

useStickySession.description: Whether to enable per-session access (true/false). Available for TCP, UDP, HTTP, HTTPS protocols

name: ncloud_change_target_group_config
